content.text:
`GET /health` now returns `{ "status": "ok", "version": "1.4.2" }`. `npm test` passes all 7 tests, including a new one for this endpoint.

- **`src/config/index.js`:** it now reads `version` from `package.json`, so the version is only defined in one place. It is exposed as `config.version`.
- **`src/server.js`:** the `/health` route is registered before the other routers. That means it isn't behind any auth middleware in `adminRouter`. I didn't read `src/routes/admin.js`, so that is an assumption.
- **`tests/health.test.js`:** the new test starts the app on a random port and checks the status code and the JSON body.

I added `status: "ok"` alongside the version because health checks usually expect it. If you want the version alone, it's a one-line change.
